notes: Multimeter mode tracking fixed: knob changes (resistance, diode, capacitance…) now show up — the function sync query (:DMM:CONFigure?) was gated behind a condition that never fired when the fast reading dialect worked, so bare-number replies kept the display stuck on DCV; if a firmware never answers that query, a labeled :READ? probe runs every few polls instead. Component panel: the Datasheet search button no longer 404s (alldatasheet moved their search endpoint) and the raw <svg …> text that showed next to the Datasheet/Octopart buttons is rendered as proper icons. Tooltips now open to the LEFT of the cursor with a tighter gap and can no longer be cut off at the screen edge. Oscilloscope: same connection hardening as the meter — link-drop recovery without waiting for the OS event, replug self-heal, and a clear 'lost' event if a connected scope never sends data.
